title: Keep Calm and Call Po On
description: Following security guard Po On and his team of guards as they navigate eccentric residents, demanding supervisors and the endless stream of building mishaps.

title: A Gilded Game
description: When a financial markets superstar takes a new mentee under his wing, the mentee has to keep up and learn quickly. Entering the fast-paced world of high finance and tackling an IPO on his first outing, he finds himself surrounded by competition eager to overtake him and break his newly formed association with the company's kingmaker.

title: White Lotus Cult
description: A young hero enters a martial-arts tournament.

title: Roaring Wheels
description: Thugs force a retired and disabled motorbike-racer (Dave Wang) to compete against a past opponent.

title: City Hero
description: Five idealistic rookies learn the ropes while training for Hong Kong's elite police squad.

title: OMG! Mom's Big News
description: In an era of rapidly declining birth rates, a 53-year-old mother unexpectedly becomes pregnant. A once-peaceful family is suddenly thrown into a whirlwind of a pregnancy preservation battle. What kind of impact and changes will the arrival of this new life bring to them?

title: Wushu
description: Five students join a martial arts school in China and learn the disciplines of wushu. Ten years later, their skills are put to the test when a student enters a child-kidnapping ring.

title: Stuntman
description: A washed-up stunt director is struggling to find his way in a changing industry. He risks everything to stage a comeback, while also attempting to repair the relationship with his estranged daughter.

title: Hong Kong i-CABLE News
description: Presenting news, updates and developments including the current affairs pertaining to politics, sports and entertainment from Hong Kong.

title: L for Love, L for Lies
description: Bobo (Stephy Tang) thinks she has the perfect life. She's just graduated from college, is in love with her boyfriend, Chun (Ka-Lok Wong), and runs her own business. But everything falls apart when her friend Kiki (Alice Tseng) steals Chun away from her. Bobo finds a job working as a makeup artist and consoles herself with her friends Man (Leila Tong) and Fung (Terry Wu). Her life becomes even more complicated when she reunites with an old friend, who helps her get revenge on Chun.

title: Happy Hour
description: Three friends (Jordan Chan, Julian Cheung, Andy Hui Chi-On) maintain their innocence after a woman they met in a bar claims she was raped.
